judgment_text:
COMMON PRAYER in C.M.P.(MD) No. 3641 & 3642 of 2026 : - Petitions filed under Section 5 of the Limitation Act, to condone the delay of 305 and 305 days, respectively, in filing above review application.

COMMON PRAYER in REV. APLW.(MD) Nos. SR 12048 & 12059 of 2026 : - Review filed under Order XLVII Rule (1), 114 of CPC, to review the order dated 11-3-2025 in W.P.(MD) Nos. 6491 & 6492 of 2025.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

N. Sathish Kumar, J.:— The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner in both petitions seeks permission of this Court to withdraw these Civil Miscellaneous Petitions. She has also made an endorsement to that effect in the Court record.

2. Recording the same, these Civil Miscellaneous Petitions are dismissed as withdrawn. Consequently, connected review applications are rejected at SR stage itself. No costs.
